messages.罪悪共鳴の数に応じて、複数の味方を回復しつつ、共鳴した属性のバフを配る回復・補助: A healing and support E.G.O that heals multiple allies based on the number of Sin Resonance while handing out buffs for the resonating Sin.
messages.共鳴数に比例する強化: 最も高い共鳴が3以上なら攻撃加重値が増える(解析Ⅲで最大: **Bonuses scaling with Resonance**: If the highest Resonance is 3 or more, Attack Weight increases (up to 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ, up to 3 at Ⅳ). The number of buff and healing targets also increases with more Resonance.
messages.バフ: 最も高い共鳴の属性について、ダメージ量増加と威力増加を1ずつ味方に付与す: **Buffs**: Gives allies 1 Damage Up and 1 Power Up for the Sin of the highest Resonance. At 4 or more Resonance, extra Damage Up is added, and at Threadspin Ⅲ with 5 or more Resonance, extra Power Up is added too.
messages.次ターンへの持ち越し(解析Ⅳ): 完全共鳴6以上なら、同じバフが次のターンにも付: **Carrying over to the next turn (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: With 6 or more Absolute Resonance, the same buffs also apply next turn.
messages.回復: 体力比率が最も低い味方を最大値の15%(解析Ⅲで18%、Ⅳで22%)回復: **Healing**: Heals the ally with the lowest HP ratio by 15% of max HP (18% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 22% at Ⅳ).
messages.重い資源: 全属性2つずつの計14個が必要で、精神消耗は30。: **Heavy requirements**: Needs 14 resources, 2 of every Sin, with a Sanity cost of 30.
messages.特定の属性に偏った編成で、共鳴を作ったターンに撃つ。: Fire it on turns when a team skewed toward a specific Sin has built Resonance.
messages.資源が偏りやすい編成では、14個を揃えるのが前提になる。: In teams whose resources tend to be lopsided, gathering all 14 is the premise.
messages.パッシブ「薔薇の冠」は敵に破裂2を付与するが、数値が小さい。: The passive Crown of Roses inflicts 2 Rupture on enemies, but the value is small.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復とバフの対象が増え、共鳴5以上で威力増加が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Increases healing and buff targets, and adds Power Up at 5 or more Resonance.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復量と対象が大きく増え、完全共鳴6でバフを持ち越せる。使うなら強化したい: **Ⅳ**: Greatly increases healing amount and targets, and buffs carry over at 6 Absolute Resonance. If you use it, upgrade it.
messages.ラ・マンチャランド 神父: S3と守備が色欲で、このE.G.Oの色欲共鳴に加わり: **[The Priest of La Manchaland](persona:1210)**: His S3 and Defense skill are Lust, making it easy to join this E.G.O's Lust Resonance. He also has plenty of self-healing.
messages.LCE E.G.O::AEDD: S3と守備が嫉妬で、嫉妬共鳴を作りやすい。: **[LCE E.G.O:: AEDD](persona:1215)**: His S3 and Defense skill are Envy, making Envy Resonance easy to build.
